notes: Bottom-left read-out turns green when you hit centre, a perfect square or circle, or exactly 0, 90, 180, 270 or 360 degrees.

19 new draw shapes: diamond, pentagon, hexagon, octagon, parallelogram, trapezoid, chevron, plus, block and double arrows, lightning bolt, heart, cloud, moon, ring, semicircle, speech bubble, 4-point star and right triangle.
Outline width is now a slider with fine control; solid shapes fill correctly again.
Delete button on every layer in the layer list.
Right-hand panel headings are blue when closed and green when open.
